settings.question: How do I start a subscription?
settings.answer: Select your product, choose a delivery frequency, and click 'Subscribe & Save' on the product page. You'll need a Sprout account to manage your subscription going forward.

settings.question: Can I skip or pause my subscription?
settings.answer: Yes — log in to your account, navigate to your active subscriptions, and choose to skip a delivery or pause entirely. No penalties apply.

settings.question: How much do I save with a subscription?
settings.answer: Subscribers save a minimum of 10% off the standard retail price on every order, plus free standard shipping on qualifying orders.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery frequency?
settings.answer: You can update your delivery schedule at any time from your customer account — no need to cancel and start over.

settings.question: Is there a cancellation fee?
settings.answer: None at all. There are no lock-ins or fees. Cancel before your next order processes and your subscription ends, no questions asked.

settings.question: When should I transition from Infant Formula to Toddler Drink?
settings.answer: Sprout Toddler Drink is designed for little ones from 12 months. When your child is ready, Sprout Toddler Drink continues the same clean, plant-based nutrition profile they're used to.

settings.question: Can I mix Infant Formula and Toddler Drink during the transition?
settings.answer: We recommend transitioning gradually. You can introduce Toddler Drink alongside Infant Formula over a week or two, increasing the proportion of Toddler Drink as your little one adjusts to the taste and texture.

settings.question: Will the taste be different when we switch?
settings.answer: The Sprout Toddler Drink has a very similar flavour profile to our Infant Formula — both are lightly sweet and rice-based — which makes the transition easier for most little ones.

settings.question: What if my toddler refuses the Toddler Drink at first?
settings.answer: It's normal for some children to take a little time adjusting. Try warming it slightly, mixing a small amount into a familiar meal, or gradually blending it with the formula they're used to. Reach out to us at hello@sproutorganic.com.au for personalised support.
